de1.P4.C2.ghi_chu: Phan c: voi de da in (x + y)^2 - 10(x + y)z + 5z^2 thi khong phuong an nao dung, vi hang dang thuc can 25z^2; loi giai kho tu doi 5z^2 thanh 25z^2. Ngoai ra phuong an B va C con trung nhau (cung bang ((x + y) - 5z)^2). Cac phan a, b da kiem va dung. Nho thay doi chieu ban de goc (co the so dung la 25z^2).
